{{Youmay|port|[[Nuso Esva]], the [[Storm-hair]] who adopted the name of Lord Odo}}
'''Odo''' was a port of entry for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travelers, specifically those visiting [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Visitors had to have visas stamped on their [[Intergalactic Passport]]s in order to enter through Odo.
